balls.text: there is the century, Sachin Tendulkar does it off the last ball of the innings, low full toss outside off that he eases through extra cover, muted celebration from Sachin, walks off raising his bat off a  Wankhede that has gone crazy
SAchin Tendulkar gets to 99 with a mow across the line that beats a desperately diving long on

Rayudu runs himself out to enable Sachin to get back for the second, in the blockhole from Vinay, squeezed past the non-striker, they were always going to go for two, but there was only one to be taken, despite George Binoy going, 'Do bhaag, do bhaag.' (Run two, run two)
gets this one away, angled on the pads, and he beats short fine leg with the pick-up sweep

slow bouncer, Sachin waits and waits and misses out completely as it rises slowly, and then raises his arms towards the umpire, looking for a wide, he isn't getting it, Rayudu wanted the bye, he is not getting it as well
slogged away to deep square leg and Sachin is on strike now, can he do it? He has the Orange Cap already though
driven wristily towards point, overthrow allows them another run, but Sachin will be off strike, and on 90
Sachin is getting the slogs right off the middle of the bat, this one is wide outside off and he reaches out to murder it high over long off
full delivery helicoptered away, in complete Dhoni fashion, one leg in the air, and long on has no chance
full toss outside off, Rayudu is in the crease and smokes it down to long off
sprayed wide outside off, Rayudu cannot get to it, not called a wide
bent the knee for the sweep but decided at the last instant to drive it towards point
sweeps a very full one from around off stump, straight to short fine leg though, RP's figures look as if they are from another match
Rayudu has played this shot brilliantly today, lofts another one down the ground, long off is very straight and fields
hammers away a full one but right to extra cover, just makes it in time at the non-striker;s
Sachin goes for one more slog from the crease to one that is going across him on a length, cannot connect
goes hard at a very widish and full one, gets it off the edge on the bounce to third man, another 50 for the impressive Ambati
bends the knee and picks up a fuller one from outside off and gets it past square leg
going hard at everything, smashed down to long on
cannot get bat to ball for once, outside off and he makes room only to miss with the swing
fired very short and wide down the leg side
looks to loft inside out again, but Jadeja darts this one in, and he cannot tee off
creamed down the ground for another single
hit away through extra cover for a single
skips out of the crease and lofts this one inside out, dropped by the man at sweeper cover running to his right, very tough chance
another slog, this one was fuller, so Sachin plays a slightly helicopter-shot-looking slog and beat the man at long on easily
big slog from Sachin, takes a length ball from outside off and hammers it over midwicket and in to the crowd
sprays this one wide outside off with another slingy delivery
Rayudu smokes this fuller one down the ground, long on somehow manages to stop it
tries to repeat the pick-pull over square leg again, this time gets it squarer on the bounce to deep square leg
another one slung in Malinga-fashion wide outside off, he stretches out for it but misses
Sachin has had enough of the straight boundary, this time he walks across and picks this short one over deep square leg, all the way

huh, Vinay comes in off his run-up, and then suddenly, stops in his delivery  stride, Ashwin style, and sends in one with a round-arm action like Malinga, three bowlers in one ball, pushed away to covers by the surprised batsman
another big one, Rayudu is showcasing his much talked-about talent, takes another one on the full and smokes it over wide long on, just clears the boundary in the end
comes out again but cannot beat extra cover this time
makes room and slams a fuller one to sweeper cover
takes this one on the full as he comes down the track, and pushes it to long off
pushed back to the bowler, Sachin just makes it back in time and then gives Powar a friendly punch on the shoulder
and is swing with the turn first ball, Rayudu charges out and finds the wide long on boundary
another boundary, all gone wrong for Jadeja this over, this time Sachin comes out and takes off, same area, the straight boundary is being peppered by these two
now the single down the ground to long on
Ambati is teeing off quite regularly now, another lofted boundary straight down the ground
tries to do it again, but Jadeja fires it in the pads, and he pushes it back down the track
bosh! Rayudu is targeting the straight boundary, and hitting it quite often, charges out, takes it on the full, and creams it to the straight boundary
half-century for Sachin, shuffles and flicks a fuller one to deep square leg
chopped away towards point
now Ambati connects, and sends a length ball soaring straight over the sight screen
now Rayudu misses out, shuffles outside off and tries to swing it away on one leg
tries to play the pick-up shot over fine leg, but takes it on the pads outside off
walks across the stumps, but cannot get this one away, pushes it back to Thisara
squares Rayudu up with a length ball outside off, he gets it away off the edge to third man
looks to go over the bowler, but Jadeja leaps high and takes the bump ball
pushed away back to the bowler, tight over from Jadeja till now
takes this on the full and pushes it to long on
now Rayudu comes down the track, but fails to connect with this one that os darted in on the pads
some forward defence from Rayudu amid all the big hits
dances down the track, and swings this flat delivery on the bounce to long on
drives this length ball to long off, big over for Mumbai
Raiphi is going for plenty, Sachin goes down on a knee, takes it from outside off and easily clears short fine leg
still fuller this time, he creams it down to long off along the ground
another maximum from Rayudu, he is cashing in on Gomez's friendly pace, this time he lofts one inside out over wide long off
Rayudu tees off, in his slot on a fuller length and he lifts it over wide long on effortlessly
another diving stop in the covers, Brendon has been superb in that area today, Rayudu has to quickly rush back in to his crease
this time Rayudu comes out of his crease, but Jadeja drags the length back and he pushes it towards covers
tries the charge again, but gets it off the inner edge down towards long on
skips down he track and smashes it with the turn wide of long off who somehow manages to get to the ball and stop it with a dive
pushed away down the ground to long on
slightly short, he rocks back and pulls away to deep midwicket
outside off and turning away from a length, pushed away towards covers where Brendon makes a good stop
diving stop at short extra cover, it was driven to his right but he got there quickly
walks across and whips one on middle and leg to short fine leg who fails to field cleanly
straight drive from Sachin, pushes a full delivery just past the non-striker;s stumps
and gets a thick edge down to third man as he goes forward weakly to a fuller one outside off
Raiphi ends Davy's painful stay this time, in the blockhole, Davy was surprised, played all over it and found his off stump rattled
likes Raiphi;s friendly pace, goes down on the knee and slogs him over midwicket
comes down the track and whips it wristily and with a big flourish, wide of deep midwicket
goes very hard at it , long off is in business again
belted away to sweeper cover
fuller one around off and Davy drives down the ground to long off

eases this one past point, lovely timing on this one from Davy, but Hodge runs in hard from third man and dives to stop the ball with his foot, almost kicks it back in football fashion, like a tackling defender would have done
called a wide, didn't look to be one, Davy went hard at it from the crease and, well, missed
straightening around off stump from short of a length, Sachin shuffles and pushes it away towards long off
hit away to sweeper cover, and Sachin will keep strike
tries to go for a big forcing pull to one that is not short enough, the ball hits him high on the pad outside leg
gentle delivery on a fuller length outside off, Sachin cannot get it past Gomez
throws his bat at a wide one outside off stump, there is a man at sweeper cover
meanwhile Davy continues to find the field, this one is pushed away to short extra cover
another one hits Sachin on the pads, looks to sweep from outside off, but misses
full one down the leg side, he misses it as he takes a step out and tries to flick it fine
now he goes for the pull, but misses this short delivery, and is hit on the body
wants to belt a very full and wide one outside off through covers, manages a bottom edge
goes hard at this one around off, flies away on the bounce to short extra cover
pushed away towards covers
now he goes for a fuller one outside off, gets the outside edge that just eludes the keeper, no doubts whom luck is favouring today
whacked! Thisara starts off wide outside off, and Sachin hammers it through extra cover on the up
going straight on outside off from a length, Davy goes for the big drive, but is too late on the shot
walks across to counter the movement, some bother but in the end gets the fuller one through square leg
now RP hits him on the pad as he gets one to straighten on a length, looked to be going down leg
short one, he swivels and pulls through midwicket, they take a couple as the ball is fielded just inside the rope
full and swinging down leg stump, he gets it a tangle outside leg, but they pinch the run as the ball rolls towards RP
fuller one from RP, he comes forward and pushes it to cover
bash! completely in control of this one, well outside off and he cashes in, cutting it past point
good ball from Vinay, straightening outside off from a length, but this time Sachin is ready, opens the face at the last instant and beats third man comfortably, super timing
very full delivery outside off, Davy tries to drive it through covers but gets it off a thick edge to the left of a diving point, third man fields
shuffles across a long way and gets bat to it this time, getting a single in front of square leg
and again he hits the pads, but this time well outside off Sachin shuffles across too much

and another lbw appeal from Vinay, he is troubling Sachin with some good deliveries, this one cuts back in from a length around off, and strikes Sachin on the pads, not given again, Sachin is lucky again, even this one was hitting the stumps, off this time
misses out again, tried to turn this short of a good length ball fine on the leg side
this one is right off the middle of the bat, but it is a forward defensive on the off side
again Davy is troubled by the incoming delivery, charged at it looking to go over the off side, and could not connect
close to off stump, and Sachin gets the bottom edge towards point
this one is fuller, angled in  on leg, and tucked away towards midwicket
Davy is not being able to get RP away, the movement in to him is getting him in to awkward positions, misses this on
Sachin walks across the stumps, could be dangerous, but gets it away off the pads fine down the leg side, they appeal for the lbw, replays that was hitting leg stump, Sachin is lucky to be there
super delivery from VInay, draws Sachin forward, gets it to move away just enough to beat Sachin's push, keeper is very interested, Vinay not so much, umpire not at all
overcooks the angle on this one, slides it down leg from a fuller length
length ball on the pads, Sachin has been flicking them away since ages, gets a couple in front of square leg
Vinay offers some width outside off, Sachin goes hard at the cut, and gets it over point, Gomez at third man messes the diving stop and the ball trickles over the ropes
Vinay goes up for lbw, this one was angled in to the pads, and Davy missed the flick, again they pinch a single even as Vinay is appealing, going down leg
good start from VInay, length ball outside off that swerves away off the seam, Davy comes forward and shoulders arms
Davy gets in to a tangle as another one from RP jags back in, tucking him up, but Sachin pushes him for the single and makes it safely to the other end
goes for the big pull, but does not connect, is struck high on the pad, but it was outside the line of off

no need to run for that one, fuller still from RP around off, Sachin seems to just push at it, covering for the inward movement and it races between the non-striker and hi stumps, mid on chases in vain
close one for Sachin, tucks one off the pads, but square leg is on to it quickly, Sachin had charged down the track for the single, but was sent back by Davy, direct throw and he was gone
this one is a bit fuller, and on leg stump, comes back in and allows him to tuck towards square leg for a single
comes back in sharply from short of a good length, Davy is surprised as it takes off at his throat and fends it away
it is Jadeja who finishes it for Kochi, gets one more low full toss and scythes it over wide long on, roars and roars as the ball disappears beyond the boundary, Sachin watches the ball go helplessly
Ravindra Jadeja gets a full toss and murders it high over the deep midwicket boundary, Kochi are closing in now
another charge from Hodge, gets the inside edge in front of square
down the track and swings a flat one wide of sweeper cover, they come  haring back for the second, and just make it
goes for the big one, this is fuller, and Jadeja lofts it straight back ,Pollard leaps in the air and stops the six with one hand, comes down while parrying the ball in, what an effort
Pollard at long off comes rushing to his left, Jadeja had mowed it down the ground from outside off, long on had it covered, but Pollard came in his way and parried it to the boundary
Hodge gets this one away, eight off the Malinga over, Kochi will take it, full on the stumps and he rocks back and swings it past the bowler, beats long on in the end
another one in the blockhole, lovely delivery, Hodge digs it out to Pollard at midwicket
Hodge backs away and gets this one away, full on the stumps and he squeezes it past a diving point
gets the yorker right on target, he cannot do anything with it, dug out towards extra cover
goes for the yorker, Hodge pushes the full delivery towards Sachin at extra cover
Baz has given it away, bends one knee and goes down outside off looking for the scoop over short fine leg, misses the full delivery, and has the leg stump knocked back, huge wicket for Mumbai
Jadeja goes down on the knee for the big mow over midwicket, misses this one going across him
low full toss on leg stump, gets away with it as he swings it to deep midwicket
this time Baz gets four, goes down on the knee and whips a length ball over square leg, just bounces inside the boundary
looks to swing this one out of the ground, but it bounces wide of the man running in from deep midwicket
hammered straight down the ground, and a diving stop by long off saves another boundary, it was Ambati, they scurry back for the second
clatter! Baz backs away, gets front leg out of the way, and smokes Pollard right away over extra cover
Kochi get four off the last ball, fuller one, Jadeja smokes it past Munaf and in to the straight boundary
Jadeja gets a wide one outside off stump and cuts it over point, a fumble in the deep and they take on the throw, Baz makes it just in time
Baz contorts himself in to a spread-legs position for the Dilscoop, and gets the low full toss high over the keeper
Munaf right in the blockhole, Baz cannot do anything with it, squeezes it back to the bowler
full toss wide outside off, he reaches out to it from the crease and gets it down to long off
smoked from the crease down to Pollard at long on
flat, short and turning away, he cuts it straight to backward point
full toss, comes down the track and hits it down to long off
tossed up and turning in from outside off stump, pushed on the off side
fired full on leg stump, flicked away in front of square, Sathish fumbles and allows them the second
cut off the back foot past a diving point who gets a hand to it, Jadeja crashes in to Baz while going for the run
stays on the back foot, shuffles across and works this one down to long on
another short delivery, this time outside off, Jadeja is pinned to the crease again, and belatedly tries to upper cut it, misses
hangs in the crease excepting the yorker, Malinga gives him the bouncer down the leg side
finally, finally Malinga gets one on target, incoming yorker, Mahela ends up wafting outside the line and Malinga strikes the middle stump
Mahela with the dab, it's the World Cup final all over again, wide outside off and he dabs it late fine to the third man boundary
this one goes flying back on the bounce to long off as Baz makes room and gives it a mighty thwack
biff! again wide outside off stump, he stays in the crease and scythes it over point and on the bounce over the ropes
looks to give him the charge again, and Malinga again slings this one wide outside off
fires this one wide outside off as he sees the batsman charge out
Davy gets quickly to his left to stop this fine nudge from Mahela
now Mahela skips down the pitch, off the inside edge backward of square leg
gets too close to the pitch of this one as he charges out and hits it past extra cover in the end
fired wide down the leg side
charges out, takes this one on the full and belts it well past the man at sweeper cover
squeezes a full one back to the bowler who lets it slip through his hands
tight line around off and plays it away for a single on the off side
appeals hopefully for the leg-before as he misses the sweep and is struck on the pads
played down the ground for a single, Mahela has his half-century now
half-tracker, he swivels and pulls off the front foot, Munaf gives up the chase early, running to his left from deep square leg
shot! Mahela makes some room, and lofts Harbhajan inside out from off stump, and easily beats sweeper cover
takes a tossed up ball on the full and hits it down to long off
backs away and cuts hard but straight to sweeper cover
takes this one on the full and eases it on the leg side, gets two with the minimum of effort as Pollard cuts it off
gets to his 50 with a couple down the ground wide of the man at long on
hammered by Baz, stays in the crease, bends the knee and pulls forcefully in front of square leg
tries the inside out lofted shot, but one hand comes off the blade and the ball goes in the air to sweeper cover
slow full delivery outside off, Mahela waits for a long time before slapping it past extra cover
tucked away to deep midwicket with the angle
stars off with a gentle short and wide one outside off, and gets away with it as Mahela slams in to the ground
rocks back languidly and cuts away a shortish one turning in to sweeper cover
backs away way outside leg and cuts this one from leg stump through point, diving stop on the boundary from Murtaza
goes straight on from over the stumps outside off, turned away to point
goes for the reverse sweep to one outside off and misses
Baz takes off over wide long on, goes down on the knee and mows him over the boundary
fired in flat on leg stump from round the stumps, misses the waft
Pollard gets away with a wide one outside off, cut away straight to point
Mahela with a cuter reverse dab, waits for this length ball to come on outside off, bends the knee and gets it fine behind the keeper, off the back of the bat too
turned away with an open face to backward point, direct hit and Mahela was gone, but the throw was off the mark
goes for the pull off the front foot, swings hard but misses the length ball
better from Pollard, tucks him up with a short of a length ball on middle, defended close to the stumps
sprays this one wide down the leg side
and right away, he comes down the track and lifts Pollard over mid off and in to the crowd
tight over from Harbhajan, Mahela goes down for the sweep but does not connect, taking it on the pads outside leg
comes down the track and hammers this one but cannot beat extra cover
length ball turning in, swept away to deep square leg
Mahela with the cute reverse paddle to a fuller one, Malinga gives chase and pulls it back
slightly short and he rocks back to pull to deep square leg
right away he goes for the reverse sweep, but misses this flat one going across him from round the wicket
diving stop to his left from the bowler, it was driven hard along the ground
darted on the pads, turned past midwicket
shuffles outside off and sweeps the full one backward of square to the boundary
pushed close to the wicket on the leg side, Mahela takes off for the run, Davy charges after the ball, and Mahela has to rush back
down the track and pushes it away down to long off
goes straight on outside off, he pushes for the turn, and gets an inside edge on to pad
Mahela backs away outside leg, Pollard angles it on a length, and Mahela adjusts to pulls it to the deep backward square leg boundary
strays down the leg side with the angle
dropped Murtaza at backward point fails to hold on to that upper dab that Mahela played so well in the World Cup final, he dived to his right and got two hands to it
swings this one down to long on
Baz stays in the crease, and hammers a length ball with the angle to the deep midwicket boundary
wayward ball, short and wide down the leg side, Davy does well to get a glove to it, and short fine leg tidies up
angled in on leg  stump, turned behind square leg off the back foot
dabbed away to backward point, and they take the throw on with the quick single
cannot beat mid on with the charge-and-drive, tight over from Murtaza
pushed away off the front foot on the off side
leaves the crease and goes for the big drive, Symonds is there at extra cover
goes for the reverse paddle, but gets it to backward point
good stop at extra cover, it was driven in the air off the front foot, and he saved a boundary
tossed up on middle stump, pushed away on the leg side
tight stuff from Munaf, full around off stump, he makes room and tries to squeeze it away, cannot beat backward point
misses the flick now, hit on the pads, but that is missing leg
backs away to go off side this time, but misses, and the ball bounces just over the stumps
crack! Mahela's turn to target the straight boundary, hangs in the crease and swings a length ball over the bowler's head
drives a fuller one off the front foot to sweeper cover
slogs this one from way outside off but straight to mid on
short-arm jab from Mahela, stays in the crease and pulls a shortish one between midwicket and mid on
fired in on middle and leg, played away on the leg side
swatted away over point, makes room and hammers a length ball that beats sweeper cover easily
goes back of a length now after those boundaries, dabbed away to slip
smoked off the front foot, Malinga targets the blockhole again, but it is another full one, and Baz takes a step forward and lofts it over mid off
smashes a full delivery down the ground, Lasith gets a foot to it, but it still beats mid off comfortably
Sachin runs to his left at mid off and dives to stop a drive from Baz, to the delight of the crowd
caught in the crease with the keeper close to him, pushes a length ball towards covers
Baz swings on one leg for the big forcing pull, but misses the shortish skiddy one
looks to paddle one on off stump behind square, does not connect cleanly
Munaf tight as ever on a length around off, Mahela plays it away on the leg side
rolls away off the pads behind square as he misses the flick to one on the pads
charges outside his crease again, but gets too close to the pitch of this one, rolls away to backward point
another one in the blockhole, normal service from Lasith, squeezed away to point
Baz charges out and takes this one on the full, smoking it between extra cover and mid off
full delivery on middle and leg, played away watchfully towards mid on
low full toss outside off, pushed away to covers
fires in the yorker first up, Baz squeezes it away towards Rohit at first slip, did it carry? Yes, it did, that's a drop
